charts.name: stage-a-by-check
charts.title: Stage A setup families passing each gate check, out of 8
charts.subtitle: In-sample run, 2016 to 2021. A family passes the gate only when it passes all six checks
charts.source: llm-trading-lab data/results/stage_a_gate_results.csv rows 2 to 9, columns min_events to control; thresholds from GateRules, src/swing_backtest/stats.py lines 254 to 262
charts.alt: Of 8 families, 6 pass the 150-event minimum, 7 the 24-month minimum, 0 the mean R minimum of 0.15, 0 the bootstrap interval check, 1 the recent-years check and 2 the matched-control check.

charts.name: b17-win-rate
charts.title: Win rate of the six b17 entry models against the 40% gate
charts.subtitle: Share of backtest trades won per model, 11,453 to 31,657 trades each
charts.source: llm-trading-lab data/results/b17_gate_results.csv rows 2 to 7, columns trades, win_rate and gate_win_rate_gt_40pct
charts.alt: Win rates range from 33.6 percent for scalp_put to 38.6 percent for trend_put. All six are below the 40 percent gate and fail it.

charts.name: llm-entry-direction
charts.title: Direction-correct rate of triggered signals, by LLM entry decision
charts.subtitle: 13 sessions, 2026-05-26 to 2026-06-11. Correct means the underlying moved in the signal's direction over the next 15 minutes
charts.alt: Signals the LLM executed were direction-correct 45.9 percent of the time over 37 signals. Signals it gated out were direction-correct 49.6 percent of the time over 115 signals. All 152 triggered signals: 48.7 percent.
